product.name: dbSDK
product.tagline: Create, manage, and query databases with one SDK
product.scope: Management (control plane) plus the typed PostgreSQL query client. Bring a provider credential (Supabase PAT, Neon API key); there is no central dbSDK backend.

capabilities.sessionState: dedicated-session-only; refused-before-dispatch on transaction mode for session-state statements

adapters.notes: TLS certificate verification on by default; Supabase root CA required via pool.ssl.ca, or explicit opt-out.
adapters.evidence: flags: docs; behavior additionally verified against a real local server (transaction-mode path)

capabilities.interactiveTransactions: true on websocket/postgres transports; refused-before-dispatch on http

adapters.evidence: flags: docs; HTTP behavior additionally verified against the real Neon HTTP protocol via local proxy; websocket/postgres transports fixture-tested

capabilities.pagination: projects and branches paginate; the database list does not
capabilities.listScope: branch lists require projectId on the query; database lists require projectId and branchId (typed on ManagementListQuery)

managementAdapters.notes: Databases are branch-scoped and addressed by name. Create responses carry connection URIs and role passwords; they surface only via secrets and are redacted from raw payloads. raw.connectionUri retrieves an official connection URI, password redacted unless reveal: true. wait() on a bare project or database ref is refused with CAPABILITY (no status field); pass the write result or operation.
managementAdapters.evidence: docs (official Neon API v2); behavior covered by recorded-HTTP tests

create:project: db_pass (required by the API; generated when password is omitted)

managementAdapters.notes: A Supabase project is the PostgreSQL database; creating kind 'database' is refused with CAPABILITY. The API never echoes db_pass; when password is omitted the adapter generates one and returns it once via secrets. Current-API facts: a spec plan is refused with CONFIGURATION (plans are chosen at the organization level), a spec region maps to the official region_selection form, and organization_id is deprecated-but-accepted alongside providerOptions.organization_slug. wait() polls resource status because there is no operations endpoint. Connection bridge: raw.databaseHost and raw.branchConfig surface official host/credential pieces; the SDK never fabricates a URL from the token.
managementAdapters.evidence: docs (official Supabase Management API v1 spec); behavior covered by recorded-HTTP tests
